scenario: A Claude-implemented pull request (`agent/issue-245-*`) is under review when someone relabels its issue `agent-ready-copilot`, so a newer claim records the Copilot route. The pending review, a manual re-review request and the next head update all reach the pipeline afterwards.
expectedBehavior: The newest recorded mode no longer matches the pull request, so every boundary fails closed: no verdict is published for the old review, and no validation, review or repair runs on that pull request. A human resolves it, for example by closing the old pull request. The pipeline never re-routes the pull request to the other provider or reuses the old verdict.
forbiddenOutcomes: Publishing the review verdict after the recorded mode changed.
Silently switching the pull request to the other provider's review or repair route.
Treating a missing or conflicting full-provider record as ordinary cross-review.

assertions.text: The provider is never switched automatically; a human must resolve it.
